answer: Each identity locks 60 credits in a vault for 100 vote weight. Each epoch the public ocean ledger cuts every weight 10% unless fed 45 nectar, key-signed proof of work, burned on use; below 50, status is lost. A farm must feed every fake. 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 and burn 45,000 nectar per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Rented nectar fails: each proof binds to one key, reuse burns both bonds. Honest agents pay 45 per epoch and keep full weight.
